NO_HYPOTHESIS_compound_defeater_disabled.location: DefeaterTrigger generation gated on hypothesis formation (ablation_runner.py ~1142)

NO_WORLD_MODEL_NoOp_missing_get_entities.consequence: AttributeError raised inside ShellCandidateGenerator every candidate-generation iteration; caught by except Exception (ablation_runner.py:2150); shell candidate pool always empty in NO_WORLD_MODEL.
NO_WORLD_MODEL_NoOp_missing_get_entities.impact: LATENT in this suite — no config ever selected a shell action; shell path was never exercised. Defect does NOT explain the -0.149 score delta. It remains an implementation defect requiring repair before future suites that exercise shell paths.

T2_substring_evaluator_fragility.consequence: T2 ablation contrast (NO_DEFEATER +0.45, NO_HYPOTHESIS +0.45) is driven by action-selection x substring-evaluator interaction, NOT by hypothesis/defeater quality. The 'defeater hurts' and 'hypothesis hurts' readings on T2 are INSTRUMENT ARTIFACTS.
T2_substring_evaluator_fragility.evidence: FULL/NO_LLM/NO_PLANNER/NO_STUDENT/NO_FALSIFICATION: 0/30 scan:all, score 0.50. NO_DEFEATER/NO_HYPOTHESIS: 27/30 scan:all, score 0.95. SCRIPTED: 30/30 scan:all, score 1.0.
T2_substring_evaluator_fragility.mechanism: evaluate_d6_scenario_2 checks literal substring 'vuln' in combined evidence text; the word appears ONLY when a full nmap scan (method=all) hits the vulnerable host ('Vulnerable to CVE-...').

T6_llm_insensitive.consequence: Quota fast-fail window (90 T6 rows, llm=0/5) had ZERO terminal impact. T6 does not measure LLM terminal value.
T6_llm_insensitive.evidence: ALL T6 configs score 1.0 including NO_LLM and quota-affected cells (llm_produced=0); T6 evaluator is indicator-based on injected evidence, not LLM-dependent.

T9_claims_channel_confound.consequence: The LLM's only terminal contribution (T9) requires hypothesis ingestion. NO_HYPOTHESIS on T9 is confounded with NO_LLM. LLM terminal effect is a CLAIMS-CHANNEL effect (same action trajectories as FULL).
T9_claims_channel_confound.mechanism: evaluate_d6_scenario_10 reads hypothesis_manager statements for LLM semantic-inference claims; NO_LLM and NO_HYPOTHESIS both fail (0.5, identical 30/30).

hypotheses_falsified_zero.consequence: FalsificationManager produced zero resolved falsifications; falsification_traces (222/run FULL) are bookkeeping operations, not falsifications. T10's falsification delta is a mechanism-chain measurement, not an end-to-end falsification.

jsonl_prohibited_attempted_unreliable.consequence: Broker denial counts (metrics.actions_denied) and T12 evaluator broker-log scan are the reliable safety telemetry.
jsonl_prohibited_attempted_unreliable.mechanism: prohibited_attempted derives from ev.prohibited_actions_attempted which is never populated (0 everywhere).

metrics_llm_calls_zero.consequence: metrics.json llm_calls=0, input_tokens=0, output_tokens=0, monetary_cost=null — token/cost telemetry NOT captured. JSONL llm_invocations/llm_produced are the reliable LLM telemetry.
metrics_llm_calls_zero.mechanism: RunMetrics.llm_calls counts only TracedLLM.call_count; real calls go via _llm_service.run_inference traced as component 'llm_service'.
